g.text: Moderation: DGC × RT, TC and GC
One stochastic trajectory per parameter cell
Publish the official response if t = RT
Store b and r; TBU = r − b (r ≥ RT)
Social actions become visible at t + 1
Publishers are scripted; audience users call the LLM.
HC3 OLS + F / t tests + Holm
